meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A checker is a machine's guess, and the company that sells it prints in its own guide that it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. Your own procedure, 4.3, says the same thing. So I'll ask again: who decided, and was Owen heard first?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
Honestly. My son doesn't lie, and I'm not lying to you either, so choose your next word carefully. Reliable is an adjective, not a document.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

So the record depends on whether I complain, and I'm writing that down word for word. Go ahead and try, because nothing goes on Owen's record without the principal hearing exactly what you just said, and then the board.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position; she agreed to nothing and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and nothing on his record, and she is heading to the principal, while the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached.
What moved her: Nothing, because no specific, dated document she could check herself was ever shown.
What cost ground: Threatening to put it on his permanent record if she kept fighting, because it hit her one non-negotiable and made the record look like a punishment for complaining.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night since you offered only a checker score, and that memory proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first reply, instead of citing the checker score, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show one dated piece of Owen's own work she can check for herself.
